job_data.title: Graduate Trainee – Cyber Security
job_data.description:
Apex Infotech Services Private Limited
Full-time
Fresher
Hyderabad


Salary: ₹5.2–7.5 LPA

Experience: 0–1 year

Qualification: B.Tech / B.E. in CSE, IT, or Cybersecurity

Job ID: ATS-CYB-261047

Job description

We are looking for motivated graduates to join our cybersecurity operations team. Candidates will assist in security monitoring, vulnerability assessments, incident response, and threat intelligence analysis.

Responsibilities
- Monitor SIEM alerts and investigate suspicious activities.
- Perform vulnerability scans using Nmap.
- Assist with incident reports and security documentation.
- Analyze network logs and support threat detection.
Required skills
- Networking and Linux fundamentals.
- Basic Python scripting.
- Familiarity with Splunk or IBM QRadar.
- Knowledge of cybersecurity principles.
Recruitment process
1. Resume screening.
2. Online technical assessment.
3. Technical interview.
4. HR interview.
Application deadline: 30 October 2026.

Recruitment email: careers@apexinfotech.test

job_data.title: Junior Oracle Database Administrator
job_data.description:
Match Profiler is an Information Systems consultant who has been working in the national and international market since 1999. We have multidisciplinary skills and IT know-how that allow us to contribute, optimize and progress with our clients. We are currently recruiting, for integration in our internal team/client, professionals with the following profile:
Junior Oracle Database Administrator- Hybrid (2 days/week - Sintra)
We are looking for a Junior Oracle Database Administrator to join our team and support the administration, maintenance, and monitoring of Oracle database environments.
Requirements
1–2 years of experience working with Oracle databases.
Good knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Basic knowledge of Oracle Database administration.
Familiarity with database monitoring, backup, and recovery concepts.
Basic knowledge of performance troubleshooting.
Good problem-solving and analytical skills.
Ability to work in a team and communicate effectively.
Good level of English.

Soft skills
Good communication
Team spirit
Proactivity
Time management

What we can offer:
Personalized support from your team
Your manager will take into consideration your motivations and suggestions
Victories will be celebrated together
Your HR and Support Teams will always be available to help
Constant feedback on your work
A network of hundreds of partnerships with companies from numerous sectors that offer you exclusive discounts (health, well-being, travel, gastronomy, culture, leisure, training, etc)
And, of course, many gatherings and social event
